body:
Founder ran 'sudo ./51-carepyre-console-idunapro-deploy.sh' and hit 'Failed to connect to bus: No medium found' at the systemctl --user step -- twice. Root cause: sudo strips the per-user D-Bus session systemctl --user needs, and also repoints ~/$HOME at /root for the build+secret-file steps. Fixed by adding a hard guard refusing to run as root, with a clear message to run it as themselves (fatbaby) instead -- matches every other sudo-queue script's own established 'prompts for sudo itself when it needs to' convention. Commit d8b6023.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed sudo-queue/51: must not run under sudo (systemctl --user bus failure)
